summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR share transactions under its All Employee Share Purchase Plan. On 2026-08-10, four executives (CFO Ben Bulmer, CHRO Catherine Chia, CRO Avnish Kalra, and Eastspring CEO Rajeev Mittal) each acquired small numbers of ordinary shares (36-40) at GBP 10.432961 per share on the London Stock Exchange. These are routine employee plan acquisitions, not special situations. No deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual events are present. The filing is a standard disclosure of managerial transactions, so it is categorized as None with high confidence.
